jobs.description:
Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Function Architect is needed to support software and functional changes within a complex embedded development environment. The role operates early in the development lifecycle, taking initiatives from initial ideas through to agreed technical solutions. You will work across technical and business-facing stakeholder groups to establish shared understanding of requirements, dependencies, system concepts, and the impact of proposed changes across the platform.
Key Responsibilities
Support the definition and implementation of software and functional changes in a complex embedded environment.
Work early in the development flow to translate ideas and requirements into agreed technical solutions and system concepts.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, system owners, and affected technical teams to gather requirements and identify dependencies.
Facilitate technical discussions concerning system changes, interfaces, communication flows, and cross-system impacts.
Create alignment between technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the change process.
Document agreed solutions using the established architecture toolchain.
Contribute to a structured, flow-oriented approach to embedded software change and delivery processes.
Explain technical solutions and working methods clearly, and support colleagues through pragmatic coaching where needed.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Strong understanding of complex embedded system architectures and cross-platform dependencies.
Experience with function development, system development, or system ownership in embedded environments.
Knowledge of in-vehicle or embedded communication technologies, including CAN and/or Ethernet, is advantageous.
Experience with continuous delivery and change processes for embedded software is beneficial.
Ability to document technical concepts and decisions within an architecture toolchain.

Qualifications & Experience
You have a B.Sc. and/or M.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. You bring solid experience from function development, system development, or system ownership in an embedded setting. Experience from complex automotive or embedded engineering environments is considered advantageous. The role requires fluent English and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholder groups.

Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced IMS Specialist to support and maintain a business-critical mainframe environment within the financial sector.
You will be part of a specialist team responsible for the administration, configuration, optimisation, and ongoing support of IMS and its associated databases. The role focuses on transaction performance, incident troubleshooting, and maintaining high levels of stability, security, resilience, and availability in a complex IBM z/OS environment.
What You Will Work On
Administer, configure, and optimise IMS databases.
Install, maintain, and support IMS system software.
Analyse transaction performance and troubleshoot incidents.
Support the stability, resilience, and availability of business-critical mainframe systems.
Work with TSO/ISPF in the z/OS environment.
Collaborate with specialists working with IBM MQ, DB2, and WebSphere/Liberty.
Investigate technical issues across databases, transactions, and related systems.
Contribute to operational reliability and continuous improvement.

What You Bring
Extensive hands-on experience administering, configuring, and optimising IMS databases.
Several years of experience working in IBM z/OS environments.
Experience with transaction processing and performance analysis.
Strong knowledge of TSO/ISPF.
Experience supporting large, complex, business-critical environments with strict availability and resilience requirements.
Excellent English communication skills.
An analytical, structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented approach.
Ability to collaborate effectively with other technical specialists.

Meritorious
Experience with IMS backup and recovery.
Understanding of how IMS transactions and databases interact with application code, such as COBOL.
Experience in banking or other highly regulated, security-critical environments.
Knowledge of related mainframe technologies, including IBM MQ, DB2, and WebSphere/Liberty.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably.
You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability.
Key responsibilities
Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling.

Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution.

Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management.

Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities.

Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation.

Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security.

Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes.

Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required.

Required qualifications
Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role.

Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments.

Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM.

Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics.

Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.

Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible.

Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure.

Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

Software Tester role within VCT EE I/T focused on Complete Vehicle Integration Test SIL/HIL testing. The role covers the entire testing lifecycle and contributes to the continuous improvement of test methods and environments to ensure Scania's embedded electrical systems meet high quality and safety standards.

Perform complete vehicle tests and verify complete electrical systems from a SW integration perspective (~20-30SW deliveries/4week).
Execute integration tests for both new and existing functionality.
Participate in the full test cycle, including:
Test planning
Test leadership
Test execution
Fault analysis
Contribute to the continuous improvement of test methods and test environments for current and future functionality.
Verify functionality and quality through SIL/HIL testing activities.
Support efforts to ensure Scania's embedded electrical systems are safe and of high quality for customers.

Must Have:

Verification and/or Validation experience.
Python experience.

ISTQB certification.

Experience with complete vehicle integration testing.
Experience working with electrical systems from an integration perspective.

Language:

English

Analytical and systematic approach to problem solving.
Good and precise communication skills.
Interest in understanding root causes of issues.
Interest in testing and technology.

Car Driver's license required.

SIL environment is internal Python based on Functional Mockups.

From ideas to reality. Decode the future.

At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living. 
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together. 
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
 

All about the role:

As aftermarket sales Product Owner, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining business processes to ensure efficiency and compliance for aftermarket sales and services. You will be part of the product team within IT EMEA/APAC, working cross-functionally with product, engineering and bunsiess owners to ensure that our products meet the needs of our customers and align with our business goals.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to define requirements for the core commerce platform, manage the sales backlog, monitor development team deliveries, and coordinate cross-functional dependencies with Contact Centers, Service Operations, Finance, Online Services, and B2B Operations.

 

What you'll do:

Provide guidance to engineering and commercial teams on process-related matters and foster a culture of process and product excellence.
Mirror Key Users (KU) in the markets and responsible for running KU forums. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify process and product improvement opportunities.
Work with technical teams to ensure processes are supported by appropriate tools and systems.
Ensure processes facilitate smooth delivery of product features across the product areas.
Monitor product performance, business adoption and business & tech KPIs to implement corrective actions when necessary.
Consolidate the sales backlog across multiple product areas. Manage process-related tasks and prioritize improvements based on business impact.
Support with developing a roadmap for process enhancements to support organizational goals.
Create and update process documentation, analyse the requirments and transfer it into detailed requirement specification for development team, support commercial counterparts centrally and locally to drive adoption of standardized processes across the organization.

 

Who you are:

You have a strong understanding of cross-functional business processes, systems, and postpurchase operations, with knowledge of sales, service, and financial flows and have proven experience working in product team. You are a hands-on problem solver who can translate business needs into process improvements and solutions that drive commercial growth.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have good prioritization skills and the ability to go into details without losing focus of the bigger picture.
3+ years as Process Owner/Product Owner or similar role in digital solutions supporting aftermarket sales, service, finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong product mindset and understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile teams.
Proficiency in Jira and/or Github for managing product backlogs and sprints.
In-depth knowledge of aftermarket sales processes (sales orders, payments, invoicing, refunds) related to services, extended warranties, spares, consumables & accessories
Understanding of fulfillment and logistics processes, especially in the context of spare parts, consumables and accessories is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Curious, self motivated and problem solver
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills
In-depth knowledge of the sales & distribution and finance domain in SAP (e.g. SD/GL/AP) would be beneficial

 

 
Where you will be:

This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
 

Benefits highlights:

Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 
 
We look forward to receiving your application!
 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU WILL DO
As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
You will:
Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
We are looking for people with:
Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
An example of our benefits:
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).

management, business development and executive management. Our clients include

The opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Program Manager to support
the development and implementation of international programmes and policy
initiatives related to sustainable resource governance.

Contribute to the development
of policy briefs, reports, technical papers, and knowledge products.

Represent the organisation in external meetings, working groups, international forums, and professional networks as required.

Master's degree or higher in Environmental
Governance, Environmental Policy, International Development, Natural

Experience working with international NGOs, UN organisations, development agencies, research institutions, or donor-funded programmes.
Experience in natural resource management approaches.

Want to be part of a collaborative team delivering reliable digital solutions that support thousands of passengers every day?
 
We are looking for a Fullstack Developer to join our Check-in & Boarding team. We are a small, autonomous development team responsible for systems and applications supporting passenger check-in and boarding across Stena Line. Our team is responsible for the systems and applications used throughout the check-in and boarding process. This includes everything from passenger information and travel document checks to boarding cards and integrations with other systems. We work with business-critical solutions while continuously modernising our technical landscape and moving towards a more digital and self-service passenger journey.
 
 
As a Fullstack Developer, you will work with both backend and frontend development and contribute throughout the development lifecycle - from architecture and design to implementation, testing and continuous improvement. We value developers who want to understand the problem, discuss different solutions and have an influence on how things are actually built.
 
 
Some of your key responsibilities:
 
- Develop and maintain applications and APIs related to check-in and boarding
 
 - Work across frontend and backend using technologies such as React, TypeScript, .NET and SQL
 
 - Design and develop integrations with other systems and external services
 
 - Develop new functionality based on business and user needs
 
 - Troubleshoot, maintain and improve existing business-critical applications
 
 - Contribute to architectural and technical decisions
 
 - Modernise and gradually replace parts of our legacy landscape
 
 
What you will experience
 
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
 
 
Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of developers, UX, Product Owner and other colleagues.
 
 
Who are you? 
 
You are a curious and collaborative developer who enjoys working across the stack and taking responsibility for solutions from idea to production.
 
 
You like to understand the problem before building the solution and enjoy discussing different approaches with the team. You care about quality and understand that delivering software is not only about writing code quickly, but about building solutions that are secure, scalable and maintainable.
 
 
You see modern AI tools and coding agents as a natural part of software development and use them to work smarter, while applying your own technical judgement to the solutions they help produce.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
 - Several years of professional software development experience, including C# and .NET
 
 - Experience with modern frontend development, preferably React and TypeScript
 
 - Experience building and consuming REST APIs, system integrations and event-driven systems
 
 - Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases
 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD and modern development practices
 
 - Professional proficiency in Swedish and English
 
 
Experience with OpenShift/Kubernetes, modernising legacy applications, cloud development or business-critical systems is considered a plus.
 
 
Interested?

We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced night nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine passion for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has an injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. A nanny must therefore always be present and available when he is with her, providing essential practical support.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Night Nanny – Responsibilities
He usually goes to bed around 20:00 and sleeps until 05:30–06:30, occasionally waking briefly.
Responsibilities include:
Being available and monitoring his wellbeing throughout the night.
Comforting and assisting him if he wakes.
Preparing breakfast, meals and snacks.
Completing morning routines and getting him ready for nursery.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing and spending quality time together.
Supporting his interests and activities.
Packing his nursery bag.
Making beds and keeping his areas tidy.
Child-related laundry and ironing when needed.
Light household tasks, including tidying up and wiping kitchen surfaces.
Administering medication when required.

The nanny sleeps in a separate area with the child, away from the mother.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and genuinely passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
We are looking for someone who will genuinely care about his happiness and development and bring warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!

Are you motivated by combining finance, business understanding and systems to create clear insights and support better decision-making?
We are looking for a Business & System Controller to join our Business Control team. In this role, you will support Group-wide financial reporting, planning and analysis while contributing to the development of tools and processes that enable better business decisions.
 
Some of your key responsibilities:
- Maintain and validate central planning assumptions and calculations, ensuring accurate and reliable planning across the Group.
- Coordinate and quality-assure central postings, allocations and intercompany reconciliations, ensuring correct legal-entity treatment and complete inclusion of all Group companies’ revenues and costs in closing and planning.
- Own the Group-wide capital cost calculation process, including planning and follow-up, ensuring consistent accounting treatment across closing, budgets, forecasts and long-term planning.
- Support legal-entity and management planning for the Stena Line Group, including reporting to Stena AB, and coordinate budgets, forecasts and long-term planning together with Business Analysts and Group Accounting.
- Administer the FP&A system, including planning versions, actuals transitions, reporting controls, user support and training, while managing system access according to the planning schedule and governance framework.
- Perform financial analyses across business areas, assess Group performance, respond to ad hoc planning and reporting requests, and create presentation material at Group level.
- Ensure plans are complete, consistent and realistic by following up on missing information, coordinating corrective actions and safeguarding timely delivery.
- Participate in projects and contribute to improvements in planning models, reports and processes, while identifying and resolving data quality issues, deviations and process risks.
 
What you will experience
As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you an additional benefits package consisting of travel discounts, health allowance, well-being activities, access to a benefits portal, and much more.
 
Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of 7.
 
Who are you? 
At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.
 
To thrive in this role, you enjoy connecting business needs, financial insights, and system capabilities to create solutions that support better decision-making. You are naturally curious and comfortable diving into operational details while maintaining a holistic view of how they impact the wider business. Complex challenges motivate you, and you have a talent for breaking them down into structured analyses and practical solutions.
You are skilled at translating business and finance requirements into system designs, models, and reporting structures aligned with governance and data standards. With a pragmatic and hands-on approach, you confidently challenge incomplete information, ask the right questions, and drive clarity when needed. Collaboration comes naturally, and you build trustful relationships across functions, countries, and teams. You enjoy coordinating cross-functional processes, keeping stakeholders aligned, and ensuring deliveries are completed within agreed timelines. Finally, you are an effective communicator who can present clear, structured messages that make complex information easy to understand for a variety of stakeholders.
 
Qualifications:
- A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Several years of experience within Finance, Accounting, or Business Control, including hands-on involvement in period-end closing, central postings, intercompany reconciliations, and Group-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning processes.
- A solid understanding of financial statements, including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow analysis.
- Experience working with Anaplan as an FP&A platform, or similar planning and performance management systems, preferably in a Model Builder capacity.
- Experience in capital cost calculations and related accounting and financial planning processes.
- Proven experience in establishing and executing data validation, controls, and reconciliations to ensure high data quality and accuracy.
- Practical experience applying AI tools to support analysis, reporting, or process improvement.
- Expertise in Power BI or comparable business intelligence and data visualization platforms.
- Advanced Excel skills and very good knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite.
- Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken; fluency in Swedish is preferred.
 
Interested?
